description: Illustrations, icons, vectors and clipart for thumbnails, sites, slides and branding.
description_zh: 用于封面、网站、幻灯片与品牌的插画、图标、矢量图与剪贴画。

entries.name: unDraw
entries.description: Open-source illustrations with customizable colors for any project.
entries.description_zh: 开源插画，颜色可自定义，适用于任何项目。

entries.name: Storyset by Freepik
entries.description: Editable, animatable illustrations you can restyle in the browser.
entries.description_zh: 可在浏览器中编辑并做成动画的插画。

entries.name: Humaaans
entries.description: Mix-and-match illustration library of people, by Pablo Stanley.
entries.description_zh: Pablo Stanley 的人物拼装插画库。

entries.name: Open Peeps
entries.description: Hand-drawn people illustrations you can assemble into scenes.
entries.description_zh: 手绘人物插画，可自由组合场景。

entries.name: Open Doodles
entries.description: Free sketchy doodle illustrations by Pablo Stanley.
entries.description_zh: Pablo Stanley 的免费手绘涂鸦插画。

entries.name: DrawKit
entries.description: Free and premium illustration packs for products and marketing.
entries.description_zh: 面向产品与营销的免费/付费插画包。

entries.name: ManyPixels Illustration Gallery
entries.description: 2,000+ royalty-free illustrations with color customization.
entries.description_zh: 2,000+ 免版税插画，支持换色。

entries.notes_zh: 不得转售或作为图库分发。

entries.name: IRA Design
entries.description: Build your own gradient character and background illustrations.
entries.description_zh: 自定义渐变人物与背景插画生成器。

entries.name: Absurd Design
entries.description: Surreal hand-drawn illustration packs for landing pages.
entries.description_zh: 超现实手绘插画包，适合落地页。

entries.notes_zh: 署名要求以当前许可条款为准。

entries.name: Blush
entries.description: Marketplace of artist-made illustrations with free collections.
entries.description_zh: 画师插画市场，含免费合集。

entries.name: SVG Repo
entries.description: 500,000+ open-licensed vectors and icons with license filters.
entries.description_zh: 50 万+ 开放许可矢量图与图标，支持按许可筛选。

entries.name: Iconify
entries.description: Search 200,000+ icons from over 100 open-source sets in one place.
entries.description_zh: 一站检索 100+ 开源图标集的 20 万+ 图标。

entries.name: Feather Icons
entries.description: Minimal, consistent open-source icon set.
entries.description_zh: 极简、风格一致的开源图标集。

entries.name: Tabler Icons
entries.description: 5,900+ free MIT-licensed SVG icons for web and print.
entries.description_zh: 5,900+ 免费 MIT 许可 SVG 图标，网页与印刷均可用。

entries.name: Lucide
entries.description: Community-maintained fork of Feather with active development.
entries.description_zh: Feather 的社区维护分支，更新活跃。

entries.name: Bootstrap Icons
entries.description: Free SVG icon library, usable with any framework.
entries.description_zh: 免费 SVG 图标库，任何框架可用。

entries.description: Gallery of free open-license icons for science and biology illustration.
entries.description_zh: 科学与生物插画用免费开放许可图标库。

entries.name: Flaticon
entries.description: Enormous icon catalog; the free plan requires attribution.
entries.description_zh: 超大图标目录；免费档需署名。

entries.name: The Noun Project
entries.description: Icons for every idea; free downloads require attribution.
entries.description_zh: 万物皆有图标；免费下载需署名。

entries.description: Consistent icon, illustration and music families; free tier needs a link.
entries.description_zh: 风格一致的图标、插画与音乐；免费档需挂链接。

entries.name: Heroicons
entries.description: Beautiful hand-crafted SVG icons by the makers of Tailwind CSS.
entries.description_zh: Tailwind 团队手工打造的 SVG 图标。

entries.name: Phosphor Icons

entries.description_zh: 灵活的开源图标家族，含 6 种字重。

entries.name: Iconoir
entries.description: 1,600+ hand-crafted open-source icons, free forever.
entries.description_zh: 1,600+ 手绘风格开源图标，永久免费。

entries.name: Remix Icon
entries.description: Neutral-style open-source system symbol icons.
entries.description_zh: 中性风格的开源系统图标库。

entries.name: Material Symbols
entries.description: Google's variable icon family, successor to Material Icons.
entries.description_zh: Google 可变图标家族（Material Icons 的继任者）。

entries.name: Freepik
entries.description: Enormous catalog of free vectors, PSDs and photos; free plan needs attribution.
entries.description_zh: 海量免费矢量图、PSD 与照片；免费档需署名。

entries.notes_zh: 免费档每日下载有限额。

entries.name: Vecteezy
entries.description: Free vectors and photos with attribution on the free plan.
entries.description_zh: 免费矢量图与照片，免费档需署名。

entries.name: 3dicons
entries.description: Open-source 3D icon library with 5,000+ rendered icons.
entries.description_zh: 开源 3D 图标库，含 5,000+ 渲染图标。
